clusters.name: codex-autoconnect-phase1-serial
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-002/US-003/US-004 all modify the same upstream-canonical hot file (tui/src/chatwidget/slash_dispatch.rs), the same overlay attach.rs, and the same patch-surface.md, and must land on one coherent codex submodule branch with a single submodule-pointer bump. Parallel execution would produce conflicting edits to those shared seams and to patch-surface.md. Run serially in dependency order US-001 -> US-002 -> US-003 -> US-004. US-001 (the 0o600 chmod) is independent and could land first in isolation, but is too small to justify a separate cluster.
